ov: The true finches: more than 200 species of small songbirds with stout, conical bills for cracking seeds and nuts, often brightly coloured. They include canaries, siskins, redpolls and grosbeaks, and most do not migrate.

why.p: Several finches are common cage birds, above all the domestic canary.

rg: Native almost worldwide, except Australia and the polar regions.
fx: Canaries, which are finches, were used in coal mines to detect carbon monoxide until 1986 in the UK.
Darwin’s finches of the Galápagos are tanagers, not true finches.
